ValidationRule.description: [IRM feedback row OppVR44] Requires Upsell Customer ID while in Solutioning, Negotiation or Booking Verification, NA cross-sell/upsell outside ITAD/NA EBS scope. Stage updated 2026-09-24 per IRM.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT($Permission.ECommerce_Deal_Bypass),
OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Standard_Opportunity', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Framework_Parent_Opportunity' ),
ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Cross-Sell/Upsell'),
AND( Region__c = 'North America', NOT(OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(Primary_Product_Line__c, 'ITAD'), CONTAINS($Label.QTB_SITAD_Countries, QTB_Billing_Country_Name__c) ), QTB_NA_EBS_Primary_Product_Line__c )) ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Solutioning'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Negotiation'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Booking Verification') ),
ISBLANK(Upsell_Customer_ID__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Upsell Customer ID is required to advance to the next stage. Please enter a value.
